name: BID EUCHRE
description: Bid Euchre is a North American partnership trick-taking game derived from Euchre, where instead of offering the turned-up card for trump, players bid competitively for the right to name the trump suit (or No Trump). The highest bidder must fulfill their contract of tricks, or be 'Euchred' and lose points. It bridges the gap between casual Euchre and contract games like Spades.

content.text: Bid Euchre is a North American partnership trick-taking game derived from Euchre, where instead of offering the turned-up card for trump, players bid competitively for the right to name the trump suit (or No Trump). The highest bidder must fulfill their contract of tricks, or be 'Euchred' and lose points. It bridges the gap between casual Euchre and contract games like Spades.

Evolved from standard Euchre in North America, with early forms documented in the American Midwest and Ontario, Canada, likely in the late 19th century, as players sought a more competitive bidding element.
4 players in fixed partnerships (North-South vs East-West).
24 cards: 9, 10, J, Q, K, A in all four suits.

items.text: Hasenpfeffer: Uses a 24-card deck + Joker. A bid of 6+Joker available. The Joker is the highest trump.
Pepper: 4-player variant where the first bid is always at 6, and non-bidders play a 'neutral' role.
Double Deck Bid Euchre: 48 cards, 6 players. Common in leagues.
